reading_question_types_taxonomy.target_skill: Grasping central paragraph theme (Skimming & main idea identification)
reading_question_types_taxonomy.rules: Headings outnumber paragraphs; headings express the essence, not supporting details
reading_question_types_taxonomy.common_traps: Keywords from distractor headings appear as incidental mentions inside the paragraph
reading_question_types_taxonomy.strategy: Read paragraph first, formulate personal 1-sentence summary, then match with heading options.

definitions.True: The passage confirms the statement agrees with the information
definitions.False: The statement directly contradicts the claim in the passage (Passage says X; statement says Opposite of X)
definitions.Not Given: The passage neither confirms nor contradicts; the specific relationship or claim is absent or cannot be proven

reading_question_types_taxonomy.common_traps: Confusing 'False' with 'Not Given'. If statement mentions an unmentioned superlative ('the most important factor'), it is Not Given, not False.

reading_question_types_taxonomy.target_skill: Identifying writer's views, claims, or attitude

definitions.Yes: The statement agrees with the views/claims of the writer
definitions.No: The statement contradicts the views/claims of the writer
definitions.Not Given: It is impossible to say what the writer thinks about this

reading_question_types_taxonomy.target_skill: Synthesizing paraphrase and identifying parts of speech
reading_question_types_taxonomy.strategy: Identify required part of speech (noun, verb, adjective) and grammar agreement before scanning word box.

reading_question_types_taxonomy.target_skill: Locating specific details across the whole passage (Scanning)
reading_question_types_taxonomy.rules: Paragraph letters may be used more than once if 'NB: You may use any letter more than once' appears.

reading_question_types_taxonomy.target_skill: Differentiating main assertions from distractor details
reading_question_types_taxonomy.rules: Distractors often quote verbatim phrases from the text but reverse polarity or add extreme qualifiers.

key_passage_themes: The ecological impact of synthetic dyes
The development of London underground railway
